rule_outs: Dwelling 9 m from the best section
summary: Quiet residential kerb where cars park, with homes 14-25 m away.
reasons: Homes within about 25 m all round

drivers.seclusion: East side has an apartment block and houses behind dense trees about 20 m back; dwellings across the road about 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb; a van fits in the parking lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street; occasional local traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked here, so a van is less conspicuous, though residents will see it.

flags: Mapped gate 211 m away has a way round; ignore
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy shades the kerb, mostly from the east.

best_section.where: East kerb of Wooley Street opposite the bushy strip, halfway up towards the top junction
